title: The Consent Floor
note: Renata's spine through Arc II. Writes the intake protocol that brings Ardin in as patient not prisoner. Examines him on arrival. Holds Tibor through 28 minutes of compel-working by reading him Calabrese. Gives Tibor the four-sentence slate at the doorway before he walks east. Consent floor intact.
